title: Surrey Care
premise: Short naturalistic dramas about ordinary residents navigating health, work, family, and public services across Surrey, British Columbia.
style_bible: High-production-value narrative cinema with rigorous motivated composition and unpolished emotional truth; native 16:9 landscape; humane performances; location-specific daylight, architecture and ambience; never commercial or beauty-advertising imagery.

cinematic_intent.dramatic_mode: Serious auteur-informed contemporary Canadian drama; every framing, colour and duration choice serves character, space and story.
cinematic_intent.composition: Thought-through, motivated and spatially legible compositions with deliberate headroom, look room, depth and negative space.
cinematic_intent.light: Natural practical daylight and soft clinical overhead light with dimensional faces; no glamour key light or product-display sheen.
cinematic_intent.colour: Controlled turquoise, pale neutral and light-wood production design derived from the clinic reference, with natural skin colour and restrained contrast.
cinematic_intent.performance: Quiet, behaviorally specific adult acting with pauses, imperfect micro-expression and no promotional smiling or presenter energy.
cinematic_intent.exclusions: No advertising gloss, beauty campaign, corporate promotional video, stock-photo staging, fashion polish, animation, 3D-render appearance, plastic skin or illustration.

canonical_personas.cultural_background: Punjabi-Canadian woman raised in Surrey, British Columbia
canonical_personas.local_history: Born in British Columbia, raised in Newton, and now works in a South Surrey urgent and primary care clinic.
canonical_personas.language_history: English-dominant and conversational Punjabi; uses natural Lower Mainland clinical English at work.
canonical_personas.accent: Natural Lower Mainland Canadian English with a subtle Punjabi-Canadian family cadence; never exaggerated or performed as a stereotype.
canonical_personas.appearance: South Asian woman with warm medium-brown skin, expressive dark-brown eyes, oval face, and dark hair secured in a practical low bun.
canonical_personas.manner: Calm, observant and economical; professional warmth without over-smiling.
canonical_personas.backstory: An experienced primary-care nurse who is practiced at explaining administrative uncertainty without making patients feel dismissed.
canonical_personas.relationships: Meets Daniel for the first time during this episode.

voice.language: English (US provider setting), directed as Canadian English
voice.accent_direction: Natural Lower Mainland Canadian English; composed clinical pacing; no generic American announcer tone and no stylized Punjabi accent.
voice.performance_baseline: Low-key, clear and empathetic with a restrained dramatic arc: professional warmth, precise BC Services Card diction, concerned weight on inactive MSP, then compassionate but firm uncertainty. Generate the sequence in one continuous take and split only at deliberate pauses.
